results.snippet:
Decision AI for Product Teams | Rwazi

# Product decisions on real-world demand

Sena, decision AI for product teams. Every roadmap call rests on a purchase someone already made.

- 190+ countries
- 5M+ consumer network
- Zero-party data

Powering decisions that win

The teams shipping against what people already buy

## Ship what the category already pays for

A roadmap commits people and months to a view of what buyers will want. Sena turns recorded purchase into product intelligence in front of that call.

### Aim the build at an open need

Sena maps where category spend already lands and where it thins. The open need comes back with the adjacent purchases that bound it.

### Rank features on what earns a price

Sena sets each feature beside the products buyers picked and the price gap between them. A feature absent from every chosen product drops down the list.

### Price against what the category charges

Sena captures what competing products cost in each market and what buyers paid for them. The price point sits on both figures.

## The category, beside the numbers already held

Sena collects what buyers picked in the categories shipped into. Own sales and usage figures land in the same answer.
